descriptionEs: Botón que barre dos colores desde lados opuestos.

name: Spotify Music Card
description: A music card with a track, its cover and playback controls.
descriptionEs: Tarjeta de música con pista, portada y controles de reproducción.

name: Spotlight Photo Gallery
description: A gallery where a spotlight follows the image you are on.
descriptionEs: Galería donde un foco sigue la imagen en la que estás.

name: Stagger Fade-in Animation
description: Elements that fade in one after another down the page.
descriptionEs: Elementos que aparecen en fundido uno detrás de otro al bajar.

name: Staircase Blocks Loader
description: A loader of blocks that stack like a staircase.
descriptionEs: Cargador de bloques que se apilan como una escalera.

name: Star Rating Button
description: A row of stars you click to set a rating.
descriptionEs: Fila de estrellas que pulsas para puntuar.

name: Status Badge Glow Matrix
description: A matrix of status badges each glowing a different colour.
descriptionEs: Matriz de insignias de estado que brillan en colores distintos.

name: Steampunk Pressure Manometer
description: A steampunk pressure gauge with a swinging needle.
descriptionEs: Manómetro steampunk con una aguja que oscila.

name: Stripe Progress Bar
description: A progress bar drawn as a moving stripe pattern.
descriptionEs: Barra de progreso dibujada con rayas en movimiento.

name: Supernova Remnant Nebula
description: The glowing remnant of a supernova in a nebula.
descriptionEs: El resto brillante de una supernova dentro de una nebulosa.

name: Tab Menu Neon Underline
description: A tab menu with a neon underline under the active tab.
descriptionEs: Menú de pestañas con un subrayado de neón en la activa.

name: Tag Input Chip Form
description: A tag field where each entry becomes a removable chip.
descriptionEs: Campo de etiquetas donde cada entrada se convierte en una ficha.

name: Teletext 80s Weather Screen
description: An 80s teletext weather screen with its blocky graphics.
descriptionEs: Pantalla meteorológica de teletexto de los 80 con sus gráficos de bloques.

name: Terminal Code Matrix Decode
description: A terminal that decodes a stream of falling code.
descriptionEs: Terminal que descodifica un flujo de código que cae.

name: Terminal Cursor Loader
description: A loading indicator shaped as a blinking terminal cursor.
descriptionEs: Indicador de carga con forma de cursor de terminal parpadeante.

name: Terminal Syntax Highlighter
description: A code block that colours itself like a real terminal.
descriptionEs: Bloque de código que se colorea como una terminal real.

name: Testimonial Quote Card
description: A testimonial card with a quote, an author and a photo.
descriptionEs: Tarjeta de testimonio con cita, autor y fotografía.

name: Text Scramble Hover Effect
description: Text that scrambles into unreadable glyphs on hover.
descriptionEs: Texto que se descompone en glifos ilegibles al pasar el cursor.

name: Theater Curtain Reveal
description: A stage curtain that opens to reveal the content behind.
descriptionEs: Telón de teatro que se abre para revelar el contenido.

name: Multi Theme Switcher
description: A switcher that moves between several themes at once.
descriptionEs: Selector que pasa entre varios temas de una vez.

name: Thunderstorm Lightning Strike
description: Lightning striking through a rolling thunderstorm.
descriptionEs: Rayo que cae a través de una tormenta en movimiento.

name: Tilt Perspective Card
description: A card that tilts in perspective as you move the pointer.
descriptionEs: Tarjeta que se inclina en perspectiva al mover el puntero.

name: Toggle 3D Button
description: A button that flips in 3D to its other state.
descriptionEs: Botón que gira en 3D hacia su otro estado.

name: Toggle Switch Group
description: A group of switches you can turn on together.
descriptionEs: Grupo de interruptores que se activan a la vez.

name: Typewriter Mechanical Key Press
description: A typewriter that presses each key as the text appears.
descriptionEs: Máquina de escribir que golpea cada tecla al aparecer el texto.

name: URL QR Code Generator
description: A form that turns any URL into a scannable QR code.
descriptionEs: Formulario que convierte cualquier URL en un código QR escaneable.

name: VCR Glitch Recording OSD
description: A VHS on-screen display with tracking glitches and timecode.
descriptionEs: Información en pantalla de VHS con fallos de tracking y código de tiempo.

name: Vertical Volume Slider
description: A volume control that slides up and down.
descriptionEs: Control de volumen que sube y baja.

name: Vintage Film Projector Reel
description: A film projector whose reels turn and flicker.
descriptionEs: Proyector de cine con las bobinas girando y parpadeando.

name: Vintage Meter VU Audio
description: A VU meter whose needle swings with the audio level.
descriptionEs: Vúmetro cuya aguja se mueve con el nivel de audio.

name: Warp Speed Star Hyperdrive
description: Stars stretching into streaks at warp speed.
descriptionEs: Estrellas estirándose en trazadas a velocidad impulso.

name: Wave Accordion Stack
description: An accordion whose panels stack in a wave.
descriptionEs: Acordeón cuyos paneles se apilan en forma de ola.

name: Wave Text Animation
description: Text that undulates in a wave, letter by letter.
descriptionEs: Texto que ondea en forma de ola, letra a letra.

name: Weather Forecast Card
description: A weather card with the forecast for the coming days.
descriptionEs: Tarjeta meteorológica con el previsión de los próximos días.

name: Webhook Event Payload Stream
description: A stream of webhook payloads arriving one after another.
descriptionEs: Flujo de cargas útiles de webhooks que llegan una tras otra.

name: WebSocket Handshake Anim
description: A WebSocket handshake shown step by step as it opens.
descriptionEs: Apertura de sesión WebSocket mostrada paso a paso mientras se conecta.

name: WiFi Signal Preloader
description: A loading indicator shaped like rising WiFi bars.
descriptionEs: Indicador de carga con forma de barras de WiFi que crecen.

name: Zoom Hover Photo Gallery
description: A photo gallery that zooms in on hover.
descriptionEs: Galería de fotos que hace zoom al pasar el cursor.

name: Bokeh Depth Of Field
description: Night city lights float through eight depth planes as out-of-focus bokeh discs, and moving the pointer racks the focus plane to blur or sharpen each layer.

name: Chromatic Aberration Shutter
description: Nine aperture blades stop down and reopen while RGB channel fringing splits the edges of a faceted subject and the focus racks as the iris closes.

name: Cloud Drift Parallax
description: Four parallax cloud decks built from layered radial gradients drifting across a warm dusk sky with a low sun bloom.

name: Cymatics Chladni Figure
description: Real Chladni nodal figures computed from the square-plate standing wave equation and rendered as accumulating sand grains on a vibrating steel plate.

name: ECG Heartbeat Pulse
description: A PQRST electrocardiogram trace sweeps across medical grid paper with a glowing sweep line, live BPM readout and a heart pulse locked to the R spike.

name: Ferrofluid Spike Crown
description: A magnet sweeps above a pool of iron fluid, raising glossy black spikes crowned with iridescent highlights.

name: Fiber Optic Light Stream
description: Pulses of light enter a branching fibre bundle, split at every junction and bloom where each strand ends.

name: Firefly Swarm Meadow
description: A canvas firefly swarm wandering a dark meadow of layered grass silhouettes with soft glow sprites, blinking phases and out-of-focus foreground bokeh.

name: Fourier Epicycles
description: Rotating vectors of geometrically decaying radius rebuild a word from its own Fourier spectrum while the tip draws a glowing epicycle trace.

name: Koi Pond Ripple Trail
description: Amber and cream koi steer beneath a dark reflective pond surface, bodies undulating in travelling waves and trailing concentric ripple rings through drifting caustic light.

name: Lens Flare Anamorphic
description: A pulsing light source drives a full cinema flare stack with a blue anamorphic streak, polygonal aperture ghosts on the optical axis and drifting iris rings.

name: Lissajous Harmonograph
description: Two damped pendulums of drifting phase superpose their motion to ink Lissajous figures that reveal themselves through an animated stroke dash.

name: Mandelbrot Fractal Zoom
description: An uninterrupted dive into the Mandelbrot boundary, shaded by escape time on a low resolution buffer that is upscaled smoothly to hold a steady frame rate.

name: Mobius Infinity Loop
description: A morphing Mobius strip drawn by an animated dash reveal while a rotating lemniscate links through its loop.

name: Moire Interference Drift
description: Two counter-rotating line lattices beat against each other in blended colour to drift a seamless interference field.

name: Ocean Wave Shore Cycle
description: Six layered sea bands translate at different speeds with foam crests, drifting haze and a shimmering sun glint in one continuous cinematic swell.

name: Pixel Mosaic Dissolve
description: A procedurally generated gradient-and-shape landscape shatters into a staggered grid of squares and reforms along a glowing wavefront.

name: Rigid Domino Topple
description: A curved row of dominoes topples in a gapless chain reaction with gravity-driven angular acceleration and a damped impact rebound.

name: Sakura Petal Vortex
description: Cherry blossom petals tumble in three dimensions across a blurred grove, drifting from hazy far depths to large motion-streaked near petals, and gather into a swirling vortex around the pointer.

name: Sierpinski Fractal Growth
description: A Sierpinski triangle assembles itself one recursive generation at a time, glowing edges fading into the depths before the whole structure collapses back to a single cell.

name: Silk Ribbon Flow
description: Long iridescent silk ribbons twist through a layered violet depth field in a seamless perspective flow.

name: Snow Glacier Cascade
description: Four parallax layers of cascading snowfall drifting over a cold blue glacier wall and still meltwater lagoon in pure CSS.

name: Stained Glass Light Shaft
description: A leaded gothic window of jewel-toned glass throws animated god rays across a dark stone nave while dust motes drift through the light.

name: Sumi Ink Brush Stroke
description: A single pine-soot sumi-e pass on hand-torn kozo washi: a tapered ink ribbon revealed by a dash-offset wipe, with capillary bleed, pigment granulation, a pooled blot with wicking tendrils and a dry-brush tail.

name: Tesseract Hypercube 4D
description: A true four dimensional tesseract of sixteen vertices and thirty two edges rotating on two planes and projected through perspective.

name: Tornado Vortex Debris
description: A leaning storm funnel sweeps dust, grit and torn debris along spiralling paths while lightning flickers inside the column over a scarred plain.

name: Truchet Tile Morph
description: A grid of Truchet tiles whose glowing quarter circle arcs rotate ninety degrees and re-connect into a new continuous labyrinth.

name: Voronoi Glass Shatter
description: A tempered pane fractures along branching crack fronts into Voronoi shards that separate, spin, fall away and leave a glowing residual rim.

name: Voxel Block Builder
description: An isometric voxel monolith assembles block by block with edge glow, a build progress readout and a slowly drifting camera.

name: Watercolor Bleed Bloom
description: Pigment blooms soaking into cotton rag: a wet front spreading outward, a darker rim where pigment pools, granulation settling as the wash dries, all built from SVG turbulence and displacement filters in a staggered loop.

name: Waving Flag Cloth Sim
description: A verlet-integrated cloth lattice pinned to a mast ripples under layered wind with a woven emblem.

name: Wind Swept Grass Field
description: A canvas grass field where thousands of blades bend under traveling wind waves and rolling gust fronts that cross the whole scene.
